title: Raspberry Cream Cheese Brownies
changes_from_base: Raspberry jam in the batter and on top, a cream cheese middle and fresh raspberries.
summary: Chocolate brownies with raspberry jam in the batter, a cream cheese middle and raspberry swirls on top.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 60 g for the batter, 60 g for the top

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt. Melt the butter and chocolate until smooth, whisk in 60 g of the jam and leave to cool a little. Stir in the sugar, eggs and vanilla, then the flour mixture.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin. Beat the cream cheese with the sugar, yolk and vanilla until completely smooth.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread half the batter in the tin, spoon the cream cheese over in an even layer and top with the remaining batter.

steps.title: Swirl
steps.text: Warm the rest of the jam so it is runny, drop it over in small spoonfuls, swirl with a knife and press in the raspberries.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min, until a cocktail stick shows moist crumbs and the cream cheese layer reads at least 71 °C.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool in the tin, then refrigerate at least 2 h before cutting into 16 squares.

tips: Warm the jam slightly so it drops easily.
Pat the fresh raspberries dry before pressing them in.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days.
